title: Uncertainty-Guided Live Measurement Sequencing for Fast SAR ADC Linearity Testing
problem: Testing high-resolution Successive Approximation Register (SAR) ADCs requires extensive data collection and post-processing, increasing test time and complexity.
motivation: Reducing test time and computational overhead is essential for integrating efficient testing into production environments.
method: Proposes adaptive closed-loop testing using iterative behavioral model refined by Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) in real-time. Dynamically selects measurement points based on model uncertainty to maximize information gain, narrowing sampling intervals as estimation progresses. Directly estimates capacitor mismatch parameters determining INL.
key_novelty: Uncertainty-guided adaptive measurement sequencing for SAR ADC linearity testing.
contributions: Real-time behavioral model refinement using Extended Kalman Filter
Uncertainty-guided measurement point selection for information maximization
Direct estimation of INL-determining capacitor mismatch parameters
Substantial reductions in test time and computational overhead
limitations: Abstract lacks quantitative performance metrics; specific speedup or accuracy improvements not provided.
